decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express offer still fits the firm's fast-response positioning and is relatively cheap to keep open as a mid-speed option, even if its separate value versus other express programs is not fully resolved.

The seventy-two-hour express offer is more operationally demanding and may remain niche, but for a large German supplier with strong service logistics it is still worth keeping as a high-upside option for urgent project and downtime-sensitive customers.

An express delivery program for doors and gates has clear strategic fit with the firm's core portfolio and its continued dedicated presentation suggests enough traction and learning to justify further commitment.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm's move toward deeper advisory and service integration, and its option value is high because digital scaling and customer lock-in can be pursued at relatively low incremental cost.

The fire and smoke protection door aligns closely with the firm's certified safety capabilities and growing complex-project demand, and its stronger website prominence in 2024 indicates uncertainty has resolved in favor of retention.
